name: Deceptive-NeRF/3DGS
definition: A sparse-view reconstruction method that densifies input observations by generating photorealistic pseudo-observations via a diffusion model, treating them as real training views to overcome overfitting and artifacts in few-view settings.
summary: Deceptive-NeRF/3DGS is a sparse-view reconstruction method that generates photorealistic pseudo-observations via a 2D diffusion model to densify training data, avoiding per-step regularization costs for faster, higher-quality results.
